const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
items=json.loads(Path('.ai/task/repair-w68-20261012/NEW-TARGETS.json').read_text())
files={}
for v in items.values(): files.setdefault(v['file'],Path(v['file']).read_text())
def enc(s):
 return '"'+s.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('"','\\"').replace('\n','\\n').replace('\r','\\r').replace('\t','\\t')+'"'
problems=[]; styles={}
for k,v in items.items():
 text=files[v['file']]
 marker='section '+enc(v['section'])
 a=text.find(marker)
 if a<0: problems.append((k,'section missing')); continue
 b=text.find('\nsection "',a+len(marker)); b=len(text) if b<0 else b
 chunk=text[a:b]
 candidates=[]
 q=enc(v['old_target'])
 n=chunk.count(q)
 if n: candidates.append(('quoted',q,n))
 raw=v['old_target']
 n=chunk.count(raw)
 if n: candidates.append(('raw',raw,n))
 # avoid double counting quoted content as raw for simple strings
 unique=[]
 for style,s,n in candidates:
  if style=='raw' and enc(raw) in chunk and '\n' not in raw: continue
  unique.append((style,s,n))
 if len(unique)!=1 or unique[0][2]!=1:
  problems.append((k,v['file'],v['section'],[(x,z) for x,y,z in unique]))
 else: styles[unique[0][0]]=styles.get(unique[0][0],0)+1
print('styles',styles,'problems',len(problems))
for p in problems[:30]: print(p)
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output)

const validationCmd = `PYTHONPATH=tools python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
root=Path('.')
task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w68-20261012'
baseline=task/'baseline'
workset=json.loads((task/'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
targets=json.loads((task/'NEW-TARGETS.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
files=sorted({v['file'] for v in targets.values()})
by_locator={}
for item in workset:
    rid=item['entry_revision_identity']; spec=targets[rid]
    locator=(item['normalized_path'],item['section'],item['source'],item['source_tag'])
    if locator in by_locator: raise SystemExit('duplicate locator: '+repr(locator))
    by_locator[locator]=(rid,spec)
manifest=load_manifest(version='tome-1.7.6')
runtime=LuaRuntime(manifest); runtime.doctor(); loader=LocaleLoader(runtime)
changed=[]; failures=[]
for file in files:
    before=loader.load_path(baseline/file,logical_path=file)
    after=loader.load_path(root/file,logical_path=file)
    if len(before.records)!=len(after.records):
        failures.append({'file':file,'error':'record_count','before':len(before.records),'after':len(after.records)})
        continue
    for ordinal,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(before.records,after.records)):
        if a==b: continue
        locator=(file,a.get('section'),a.get('source'),a.get('source_tag'))
        expected=by_locator.get(locator)
        differing=sorted(k for k in set(a)|set(b) if a.get(k)!=b.get(k))
        if expected is None:
            failures.append({'file':file,'ordinal':ordinal,'error':'unexpected_changed_record','fields':differing})
            continue
        rid,spec=expected
        if differing!=['target']:
            failures.append({'id':rid,'file':file,'ordinal':ordinal,'error':'non_target_fields_changed','fields':differing})
            continue
        if a.get('target')!=spec['old_target'] or b.get('target')!=spec['new_target']:
            failures.append({'id':rid,'file':file,'ordinal':ordinal,'error':'target_mismatch'})
            continue
        changed.append((rid,file))
changed_ids=[rid for rid,_ in changed]
missing=sorted(set(targets)-set(changed_ids)); duplicate=sorted(k for k,v in Counter(changed_ids).items() if v!=1)
if missing: failures.append({'error':'missing_expected_changes','count':len(missing),'ids':missing[:5]})
if duplicate: failures.append({'error':'duplicate_expected_changes','ids':duplicate[:5]})
counts=Counter(file for _,file in changed)
expected_counts={'mod-tome.lua':78,'tome-ashes-urhrok.lua':7,'tome-cults.lua':11,'tome-orcs.lua':10}
if dict(counts)!=expected_counts: failures.append({'error':'file_counts','actual':dict(counts),'expected':expected_counts})
result={'luajit_load':'passed' if not failures else 'failed','changed_targets':len(changed),'by_file':dict(counts),'other_records_unchanged':not failures,'new_targets_exact':not failures,'failures':failures}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)
PY`;
const [v,d,l] = await Promise.all([
